categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Jet Bio-Filtration Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the life sciences consumables industry, focusing on the production and sales of biological laboratory consumables. Its main product categories include biological culture products, liquid handling products, and related instruments and consumables. The company serves both research and industrial customers, providing standardized products and customized solutions across the full life cycle from basic research to industrial application in biopharmaceuticals, cell and gene therapy, and precision medicine.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as polymer material modification (including plasma treatment for hydrophilic, superhydrophilic, and superhydrophobic surfaces), high-precision injection molding, high-precision extrusion, 3D printing material modification, and automated assembly technologies. It applies these in manufacturing disposable plastic consumables like cell culture vessels, filtration devices, and liquid handling tools. The company also emphasizes sterile processing through outsourced irradiation sterilization and maintains compliance with medical device quality standards such as ISO 13485 and GMP.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jet Bio-Filtration serves a diverse customer base including universities, research institutes, disease control centers, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, vaccine manufacturers, and biotech firms. Its products are used in life sciences research, biopharmaceutical development, cell and gene therapy, molecular diagnostics, and medical protection. The company targets both domestic and international markets, with a significant focus on industrial clients requiring high-throughput and customized solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Guangzhou. It has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and sales operations in the United States, Germany, Hong Kong, and other regions. Overseas sales account for approximately 66% of revenue, with key markets including Europe, South America, Southeast Asia, and North America. The company has established local teams and subsidiaries to support brand globalization and localized service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jet Bio-Filtration operates mainly in the midstream segment of the life sciences supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sale of laboratory consumables and production-grade tools. It procures high-grade polymer raw materials (mostly imported) and auxiliary packaging materials, some of which are self-produced by subsidiaries. The company also provides sterilization services through outsourcing. It serves as a supplier to both research institutions and industrial biopharmaceutical manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in polymer material science, precision manufacturing, and intelligent automation to support emerging fields like cell and gene therapy (CGT). It focuses on developing high-value-added products such as storage bags, cell culture vessels, filtration membranes, and closed-system transfer devices. R&D efforts include proprietary ultra-filtration membranes, bio-reagents, and customized solutions. The company also invests in digitalization, smart manufacturing, and global brand expansion, aiming to become a core enabler in the CGT industry by integrating materials, tools, and process systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of self-developed and ODM-manufactured life science consumables. The company sells products domestically via direct sales and authorized distributors, and internationally mainly through ODM agreements with global life science service providers, supplemented by direct and distributor sales of its own brand. It also generates income from government subsidies and investment returns. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global life sciences consumables market is dominated by multinational giants such as VWR, Corning, Thermo Fisher, and Merck KGaA. Jet Bio-Filtration is a leading domestic player in China with a strong technology base and growing international presence. It competes by leveraging core polymer modification technologies and precision manufacturing to achieve import substitution and expand market share. While still behind international brands in market share and brand recognition, the company is closing the gap through innovation, quality, and cost advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 558.7 million, a 20.63% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 72.19 million, more than doubling from the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.7 billion, with a stable debt ratio of 29.67%. It maintains a healthy growth trajectory supported by expanding overseas sales, increased gross margin (41.35%), and continuous investment in R&D (4.7% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jet Bio-Filtration emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced life science consumables with superior polymer surface modifications that enhance cell culture performance and filtration efficiency. Its products meet stringent medical and biocompatibility standards and are competitively priced due to domestic manufacturing advantages. The company offers comprehensive solutions from research to industrial scale, including customized and closed-system products, supported by intelligent manufacturing and global service networks, positioning itself as a key enabler in the evolving cell and gene therapy market.
